newsitem.title: USA: Tenet says Tenet, OrNda holders OK merger.
newsitem.headline: Tenet says Tenet, OrNda holders OK merger.

text.p: Tenet Healthcare Corp said Wednesday its $2 billion merger with OrNda HealthCorp won shareholder approval from both companies, as well as regulatory approval from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
It also said its shareholders approved an increase in the number of Tenet common shares to 700 million from 450 million.

The merger is expected to close January 30, Tenet said. After its completion, each share of OrNda common stock will be converted into the right to receive 1.35 shares of Tenet common stock, Tenet added.
Tenet shares were up 1/2 in late morning trading at 25-1/4, while OrNda shares were up 3/4 at 34.
